data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure and parameters in the right order (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then the email), but it says to send the email when the true workflow ends with Discard. It also uses a full recipient_email parameter instead of {friend}@example.com, and it doesn't say how to find the search boxes or switch tabs. The Send step would make an automation do the wrong thing, which lowers feasibility.
